topic: The baby born in the Wood Sheep 'Soulmate Month' (July 7 - August 7) rides the most auspicious combination of the Fire Horse year -- soulmate signs, wood feeding fire -- but the Sheep is the sign of emotions, so this calmer-seeming baby actually needs more attention and emotional support than the double-horse baby before it.
phrases: The room gets calmer. The parenting gets harder.
Wood feeds fire. Sheep loves Horse.
Less crying up a storm. More needing you, specifically.
The elements are on this baby's side. The emotions are your department.

images.concept: A sleeping infant held against a parent's chest at dusk, seen from the side and slightly behind so no faces are identifiable, with a single warm lantern glow instead of a wild flame -- fire made small, steady, and close, rather than loud.
images.prompt: A cinematic photograph of a parent holding a sleeping infant close against their chest at dusk, shot from the side and slightly behind so neither face is visible. A single small lantern rests on a table nearby, its flame warm, steady, and low rather than wild. The room glows in antique gold and deep midnight jade shadow. The mood is tender and quiet, intimacy rather than intensity. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Two small potted plants side by side in a window, one wild and untamed with leaves reaching in every direction, the other trained gently along a stake, both thriving but requiring completely different kinds of care -- a metaphor for the double-horse baby versus the soulmate-month baby.
images.prompt: A warm photograph of two small potted plants on a windowsill in late afternoon light. The plant on the left is wild, its leaves and stems reaching in every direction, slightly unruly. The plant on the right is the same species but trained gently along a thin wooden stake, its growth guided rather than restrained. Warm antique gold light falls across both from the window. Soft sage green leaves, dusty rose light at the edges. The mood is about two different kinds of care for two different kinds of growth. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: TEXT-style card carrying the post's central myth-busting line as a punchy, quotable statement.
images.text:
The room gets calmer.
The parenting gets harder.
images.prompt: A square social graphic, 1080x1080, deep midnight jade background with a soft antique gold gradient glowing gently from the bottom edge like distant firelight. Centered in elegant, confident modern serif typography, in warm antique gold, the phrase: "The room gets calmer. The parenting gets harder." Two lines, centered, generous letter spacing, the first line slightly larger than the second. A single thin gold hairline rule beneath the text. Minimal, atmospheric, no clutter. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Overhead flat lay of a small, neatly organized set of newborn essentials (a folded blanket, a small brush, a tiny pair of socks) arranged with quiet precision, suggesting careful preparation rather than chaos.
images.prompt: An overhead flat-lay photograph on warm ivory linen. A softly folded sage-green baby blanket, a small wooden hairbrush, and a tiny pair of cream-colored knit socks are arranged with quiet, deliberate precision, evenly spaced. Soft natural window light from one side casts gentle shadows. The mood is calm, prepared, intentional rather than frantic. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Object still life: a small glass lantern with a steady low flame sitting beside a taller, unlit candle with wax pooled and cooled around its base, visualizing the shift from the wild double-horse window to the steadier soulmate-month flame.
images.prompt: A moody object still-life photograph on a dark aged wooden table. A small glass lantern holds a steady, low, warm flame. Beside it, a taller candle stands unlit, its wax cooled and pooled around the base, clearly having burned hot earlier. Antique gold light falls softly across the scene, fading into deep midnight jade shadow at the edges. The mood is contemplative, a quieter chapter following an intense one. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Close-up of a small wooden seedling stake supporting a young plant stem, morning dew visible, emphasizing gentle support rather than restraint.
images.prompt: A close-up cinematic photograph of a young plant stem gently tied to a thin wooden stake with soft twine, morning dew visible on the leaves. Warm early morning light comes from behind, backlighting the dew drops. Soft sage green and antique gold tones. The mood is nurturing, patient, quietly hopeful. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A single hand resting gently, palm up and open, in soft window light, with nothing in it -- representing presence and availability rather than action or effort.
images.prompt: A close-up cinematic photograph of a single open hand, palm facing upward, resting gently on a warm ivory linen surface in soft natural window light. The hand holds nothing. Warm skin tones, gentle shadow along the fingers, a hint of soft sage green out of focus in the background. The mood is quiet availability, presence without urgency. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A single wood-grain surface with a small trail of green moss growing along a crack, visualizing wood feeding fire and life taking root in a favorable combination.
images.prompt: A close-up photograph of an aged wooden surface with a fine crack running through it, along which a thin trail of soft green moss has taken root and is thriving. Warm antique gold light rakes across the wood grain from one side. The mood is quiet vitality, something small and good growing in an unexpected place. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
